title: Get your first users
content:
## What you'll get

A simple launch checklist to get your app in front of real people.

---

## Pre-launch checklist

Before you share your app with the world, take a moment to make sure everything works as expected. Test your app on your phone and computer to catch any obvious issues.

<Callout type="warning" title="Draft - needs review">
This section needs product confirmation: specifics on publishing an Emergent app (publish button location, URL format, access settings, custom domain options if any), plus any built-in pre-launch testing features or checklists Emergent provides.
</Callout>

---

## Where to share your app

Once your app is live, the next step is getting it in front of people who might find it useful.

<Callout type="warning" title="Draft - needs review">
This section needs product confirmation: any Emergent-specific sharing features (share links, QR codes, embed options, community showcases, or built-in distribution channels). Generic advice about communities and social platforms can supplement, but Emergent-specific features must be verified first.
</Callout>

---

## Asking for feedback

Early feedback helps you understand what's working and what needs improvement.

<Callout type="warning" title="Draft - needs review">
This section needs product confirmation: any Emergent features for collecting feedback (built-in forms, templates, analytics/usage views, or integrations). Also confirm if Emergent offers guidance on crafting feedback requests or interpreting early user data.
</Callout>

---

## Turning early feedback into next steps

Real user feedback often reveals surprises - things you thought were clear might confuse people, or features you didn't prioritize might be exactly what users want.

<Callout type="warning" title="Draft - needs review">
This section needs product confirmation: how to iterate in Emergent based on feedback (editing/versioning workflow, A/B testing if available, rollback options, or any workflow features for managing updates). Include guidance on prioritizing changes if available in existing documentation.
</Callout>

---
